name: Read-only validation of capability draft payloads
summary: capability validate --file entry.json --repo . checks one propose payload or a list before delivery. The endpoint shares propose's schema, content, requirement-link and current-key preflight without a coordination lock or any native/journal write; the client resolves code, test and anchor pointers in the checkout. Per-item results collect independent errors with field and fix hint, preserve propose's first shared error, and leave invalid items as exit-0 validation results.
